summary: Independent DAY-shift discovery review found two credible weak-signal clusters outside the current single-company score focus: grid intelligence/cyber operations are becoming an explicit infrastructure layer, and deep-space communications/launch capacity is being procured as a commercial service. These are useful 2036 dependency signals, but cadence-due discovery acquisition is not complete: FINRA remains partition-freshness only, several daily discovery families were not exhaustively reviewed in this pass, and no new public company is admission-ready from these findings.

materialFindings.finding: DOE is funding GridFM 2.0 to use foundation models for electric-grid planning at billion-scenario scale, while DOE CESER/Sandia separately reports AI-assisted grid cyber operations with near-real-time threat localization. Together these independently sourced programs support a missing 2036 dependency hypothesis: grid software/data engineering and cyber-operational intelligence may become a distinct bottleneck/control layer rather than merely an accessory to physical grid equipment.

NASA awarded Blue Origin a Mars Telecommunications Network contract with maximum potential value of about $700M and a 2028 delivery target, and separately on-ramped Relativity Space's Terran R into NASA Launch Services II. These primary NASA actions suggest that communications/navigation service capacity and diversified launch-provider capacity are being institutionalized as commercial infrastructure layers for deep-space operations.

NHTSA's September 4 Cybercab Audit Query confirms that purpose-built AV deployment can be constrained by federal self-certification/compliance even after technical deployment begins. This preserves the open hypothesis that certification/regulatory throughput is a distinct autonomy constraint, but the event remains Tesla-specific and should not yet be generalized to Earth companies without company-level evidence.

The current automated discovery artifact reports all four required probes healthy, but FINRA explicitly has observationMode=partition-freshness, eventDataAvailable=false and recordCount=null. Therefore freshness is not proof that current OTC corporate-action rows were acquired, and supervisor discovery completion must remain separate from automated coverage.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Structural lane should test whether grid intelligence/cyber-operations software deserves a distinct causal node between load-growth planning and physical grid equipment, with company mappings only after independent primary evidence identifies durable commercial beneficiaries.

Discovery/structural review should test whether deep-space communications/navigation service capacity is a missing infrastructure node separate from launch, satellite manufacturing and terrestrial communications before adding companies or changing scores.

contradictions.issue: Automated required-source coverage is 1.0 while discoveryScanCompleted is false.
contradictions.resolution: Not a contradiction when capability is modeled correctly: health probes establish source reachability/freshness, while same-cycle intelligent discovery review requires event interpretation and cadence-due source work.

unknowns: No same-cycle exhaustive review was completed for every cadence-due daily listing/procurement/regulatory family, including NYSE, Nasdaq IPO, Cboe, USAspending candidate-level events and FINRA row-level OTC actions.
No public investable beneficiary has yet been independently verified for the new deep-space communications-service signal; Blue Origin and Relativity Space are private companies.
Whether grid foundation-model/cyber operations become a monetizable bottleneck for current Earth companies versus utility/lab internal tooling remains unproven.

peerRequests.request: Test the proposed grid-intelligence/cyber-operations and deep-space communications-service nodes for non-duplication, materiality, company linkage and falsifiers before any causal promotion.
Continue preserving FINRA partition-freshness versus event-acquisition semantics and seek row-level corroboration for any material OTC event before discovery completion.

blockingIssues: Cadence-due discovery acquisition is incomplete for this cycle, so discoveryScanCompleted should remain false.

directivesReviewed.result: Capability distinction is preserved and new primary weak signals were researched, but the closure criterion is not yet met because all cadence-due active gating discovery families were not exhaustively reviewed and FINRA row-level event acquisition remains unavailable.

NHTSA primary evidence continues to support the existence of a certification/compliance constraint in purpose-built AV deployment, but company-level relevance outside Tesla remains unresolved; no canonical promotion is proposed.
